How It Works

We offer homes with owner financing, structured as a land contract (also called an agreement for deed) — a straightforward way to buy on contract, with clear terms, a down payment, and predictable monthly payments, all written plainly.

The process, step by step

1

Find a home & reach out

Browse available homes and contact us about the one you like, or tell us what you're looking for and we'll match you.

2

Let's talk

We'll discuss the home, the terms, and what works for your situation.

3

Agree on terms

Down payment, monthly payment, and length — all written in plain language, agreed up front. No hidden steps.

4

Move in and settle in

You take possession of the home and make monthly payments toward full ownership under the contract.

How a land contract works

With a land contract (agreement for deed), you take possession of the home and make monthly payments under a written agreement. You live in the home while you make your payments, and once the contract is completed as agreed, the deed and legal title transfer to the buyer. The full terms — including what happens if payments aren't made — are set out in the written agreement.

What you'll typically need

  • A down payment — agreed up front, based on the home.
  • Steady income — to support the monthly payment.
  • A commitment to long-term ownership.

About Oak Homes

Built for real-world buyers

These homes are sold as-is, without expensive renovations or retail markups. That approach keeps prices realistic and makes flexible ownership paths possible where traditional pricing wouldn't.

We keep the process straightforward, with clear terms and expectations from the start — no hidden steps, just a transparent agreement you can understand.

Built for committed buyers

This model is ideal for buyers who want to stop renting, take ownership seriously, and build something long term.
